principles.heading: Built to stand up to an audit
principles.intro: A buyer, a regulator or an auditor may ask where material came from. The record is designed so the answer is always there.

auditable.title: Every change is on the record
auditable.body: Each step (a pickup weighed, a trade paid, a load delivered) writes an entry to an audit log that is never edited in place.

exact.title: Numbers that never drift
exact.body: Money is kept in whole paise and mass in whole grams. No rounding error can build up between a weighbridge and a settlement.

frozen.title: History stays as it was
frozen.body: Every receipt keeps the price and weight of its day. Changing a price later never rewrites a receipt that already exists.

standards.title: The Luma.Green standard
standards.lead: Simple, open rules for trading recyclable materials fairly: one code for every material, clear grading, honest weighing and a record at every hand-off. Anyone in the industry can adopt them.

codes.title: One code for every material
codes.body: The same material goes by many local names. An open code gives each material one name everyone can use, so a kilo of newspaper means the same thing at a shop, a yard and a factory.
codes.caption: Luma.Green material codes
codes.unavailable: The code list isn't available right now. Please check back soon.

grading.title: Grading: dry, sorted, clean
grading.body: A fair price needs a clear grade. Three checks come before any weighing.

dry.title: Dry
dry.body: Do not include water in the material weight. Wet paper and cardboard are dried before they are weighed.

sorted.title: Sorted
sorted.body: One material per bag or bale, under one code. A mixed load goes under a MIXED code.

clean.title: No contamination
clean.body: No food, oil, soil or stones. Anything that isn't the material comes out first.

weighing.title: Fair weighing
weighing.body: Clear weighing rules help resolve disputes over material weight.

stamped.title: Stamped scales
stamped.body: Weigh only on a scale verified and stamped by the Legal Metrology department.

shown.title: The seller sees the weight
shown.body: The display faces the seller, and the weight is read out before a price is agreed.

receipt.title: A digital receipt
receipt.body: The weight goes on a receipt to the gram, never rounded in anyone's favour.

custody.title: Receipts and chain of custody
custody.body: Every hand-off gets a receipt. Receipts link from step to step, so a bale at a recycler can be traced back to the shops it came from.

howItWorks.title: How Luma.Green works
howItWorks.lead: Materials move from homes to collection shops, preprocessors and recyclers before they become something new. Here is what happens at each step, and what Luma.Green records.

sell.body: A household adds photos and collection details, then books pickup or drop-off. No estimated weights are required. The shop weighs the materials and records its payment declaration and receipt.
sell.point1: Each shop sets its own offers
sell.point2: Weights recorded in grams from the shop's scale
sell.point3: Sign in with record access to view private collection details

trade.body: Business payments use the payment gateway. Check the order for its current payment status.
trade.point2: Stock moves when a load is dispatched and received
trade.point3: A numbered trade receipt for every paid trade

record.body: Every hand-off is written down: who, what, how much, when and where. That record powers the price board, stock, compliance and impact figures, and is the evidence EPR and recycling standards ask for.
record.point1: One record from the door to the factory
record.point2: EPR totals by financial year for recyclers and factories
record.point3: Supporting evidence for credits, never counted twice

safetyAtWork.title: Stay safe at work
safetyAtWork.summary: Safety gear, lifting, sharp materials, batteries and machines: the basics that prevent injuries.

gear.title: Wear your safety gear (PPE)
gear.body: Gloves and closed shoes, always. Add a mask for dusty loads and goggles when cutting or crushing.

lift.title: Lift with your legs
lift.body: Bend your knees, keep the load close and don't twist. Get help with anything over 25 kg.

sharp.title: Watch for sharp edges
sharp.body: Glass, tin and wire cut easily. Carry glass in a box, never loose in a sack.

batteries.title: Keep batteries and e-waste apart
batteries.body: Store them dry and cool, away from other materials. Never burn wires or break open batteries or screens.

machines.title: Switch off before you clear a jam
machines.body: Stop a baler or shredder and unplug it first. Never reach in while it runs.

firstAid.title: Keep first aid close
firstAid.body: Keep a first-aid kit and clean water on site. For a deep cut or a burn, get medical help at once.

carbonEpr.title: Carbon credits and EPR, simply
carbonEpr.summary: Why recorded recycling matters, and what brands and recyclers must know.

record.title: Every kilo is recorded
record.body: Each weighing and trade on Luma.Green is logged with the material, weight, date and place.

carbon.title: Recycling saves carbon
carbon.body: Making things from recycled material uses less energy than making them new. That saving can later become carbon credits.

epr.title: EPR: makers must take back
epr.body: Extended Producer Responsibility means brands that sell packaging, electronics or batteries must get a share of that waste recycled.

certificates.title: Recyclers issue EPR certificates
certificates.body: Registered recyclers issue certificates on the CPCB portal for what they recycle. Brands buy them to meet their targets.

proof.title: Clean records are your proof
proof.body: Our trail from home to factory shows where material came from. Carbon credits on Luma.Green come later.

go.title: Call and go

show.title: Show your price

request.title: Request a load

pay.title: Awaiting gateway
pay.body: Business payments use the payment gateway. Check the order for its current payment status.

confirm.title: Weigh, check, confirm

area.body: Where you live, how far you'll travel (2, 5 or 10 km) and when you're free.

id.body: Voter ID, driving licence, PAN or a masked Aadhaar. Never a full Aadhaar number.

findJobs.title: Find and take jobs
findJobs.summary: Work near you, when you want it.

home.title: See jobs on Home
home.body: Each job shows the place, day, time and pay.

accept.title: Accept a job
accept.body: Tap Accept. The business can see you're coming.

arrive.title: Be on time
arrive.body: Call ahead if you'll be late. Being on time gets you more work.

done.title: Mark it done
done.body: After the job, mark it done so it shows in your earnings.

homePickup.title: Do a home pickup
homePickup.summary: Friendly, quick and fair at every door.

call.body: Say your name, which shop you're from and when you'll arrive.

greet.body: At the door, say your name and the shop's name. Wait to be invited in.

weigh.title: Weigh where they can see
weigh.body: Zero the scale and weigh each material in front of them.

record.title: Pay and record
record.body: Pay as the shop has asked, and save the payment before you leave.

deliver.title: Bring it to the shop
deliver.body: Take the materials straight to the shop and hand them over.

saathiPay.title: How you get paid
saathiPay.summary: Agree the pay first, then check it in Earnings.

agree.title: Agree the pay first
agree.body: The shop or business you work for pays you. Agree the amount before the job starts.

earnings.title: Check Earnings
earnings.body: See the jobs you've done and what each one paid.

upi.title: Ask for UPI
upi.body: UPI leaves a record, so there's never a doubt about what you got.

problem.title: Not paid?
problem.body: Talk to the business first. Still stuck? Call us.

noCode.q: I didn't get the SMS code
noCode.a: Check your number and phone signal. Wait for the resend timer to finish, then request a new code. Codes expire after 5 minutes.

newPhone.q: I have a new phone or a new number
newPhone.a: New phone, same number: just sign in again. New number: call us, and we'll move your account once we've checked it's you.

deleteData.q: Can I see or delete my data?
deleteData.a: Yes. Write to us from Contact and we'll do it within 30 days. We keep only what the law needs, such as receipts.

verifyTime.q: How long does the check take?
verifyTime.a: Usually 12 to 24 hours after you send your application. If we need anything else, we tell you exactly what.

noAccount.a: No. You confirm your mobile number with an SMS code when you book. There's no password to remember.

whatCanISell.a: Paper and cardboard, plastic bottles and containers, metal, glass and old electronics.

howPriceWorks.q: How is my money worked out?
howPriceWorks.a: The measured weight of each material times the agreed shop price per kg. Reference prices are information only.

howPaid.a: At your door, in cash or UPI, before the kabadiwala leaves. Luma.Green records the payment but never holds your money.

recyclePoints.a: A thank-you for recycling: 1 point for every ₹10 you're paid. What you can use them for is coming soon.

weightWrong.q: What if the weight looks wrong?
weightWrong.a: Ask them to weigh it again in front of you, starting from zero. Still not right? Call us: the receipt shows every weight.

canCancel.a: Yes, for free, until the kabadiwala is on the way. Open your tracking link and tap Cancel.

kabadiwalasChecked.a: Yes. Our team checks every shop before it can take bookings. Look for the verified badge.

whoSeesAddress.q: Who sees my number and address?
whoSeesAddress.a: Only the kabadiwala who accepts your pickup, and our team. We keep them for 12 months after your last booking.

photosKept.a: Photos are saved privately with your request. Only people with access to the request can view them. Keep faces, documents and number plates out of photos.

whyVerify.q: Why do I have to be verified?
whyVerify.a: Households trust you at their door. Checking every shop keeps them safe and makes your verified badge mean something.

gstNeeded.q: Do I need a GST number?
gstNeeded.a: No, it's optional. Add it if you have one.

ownPrices.q: Can I set my own prices?
ownPrices.a: Yes. Each business sets its own offers for each material. Reference prices are not a required minimum.

noVehicle.q: I don't have a vehicle. Can I still join?
noVehicle.a: Yes. Households can bring materials to your shop. Saathi collections for shops without a vehicle are coming later.

autoAccept.a: When it's on, every new request in your area is accepted straight away, even at night. Turn it off when you can't go.

rejectRequest.q: What happens if I reject a request?
rejectRequest.a: The household can choose another shop and send a new request.

payHousehold.q: Does Luma.Green pay the household for me?
payHousehold.a: No. You pay them in cash or UPI at the door. The app records how much and how.

paidByYard.q: How am I paid when I sell to a preprocessor?
paidByYard.a: Business payments use the payment gateway. Check the order for its current payment status.

whoSeesShop.a: Once you're approved, your shop name, area and hours are public so households can find you. Your documents stay private.

consentDocs.a: Your pollution-board consent (KSPCB in Karnataka) with its number, valid-until date and certificate as a PDF, plus photos of your machines. GST is optional.

noConsentNeeded.q: My unit doesn't need a consent. Can I still join?
noConsentNeeded.a: Yes. Tick the box that says your unit doesn't need one, and tell us why, for example paper baling only. We check it.

consentExpiry.q: What happens when my consent expires?
consentExpiry.a: Check the expiry date in Compliance. It flags consent with fewer than 90 days left. Renew with your pollution control board and contact support to update the certificate.

findStock.q: How do I find stock near me?
findStock.a: Open Buy. Stock from verified kabadiwalas is shown by material, nearest first.

whoSetsPrice.a: The seller lists a price per kg. You see it before you send a request, and you can call to agree details.

whatIsEscrow.a: Business payments use the payment gateway. Check the order for its current payment status.

whenSellerPaid.a: As soon as the buyer confirms delivery.

shortLoad.q: What if a load is short?
shortLoad.a: The demo shows proposed dispute steps. It cannot hold or protect real funds.

ewayBill.q: Do I need an e-way bill?
ewayBill.a: Yes, to move goods worth more than ₹50,000, and the trade screen reminds you. Some states set a different limit.

whoSeesBusiness.a: Verified buyers and sellers see your name, area and the materials you handle. Only you and our team see your documents.

pwpRegistration.q: I recycle plastic. Do I need anything more?
pwpRegistration.a: Keep your CPCB Plastic Waste Processor registration ready. Brands ask for it, and it lets you issue EPR certificates.

buyFromAnyYard.q: Can I buy from more than one preprocessor?
buyFromAnyYard.a: Yes. Buy from any verified preprocessor that lists what you need, as often as you like.

eprRecords.q: Do Luma.Green records help with EPR?
eprRecords.a: Yes. Every trade records the material, weight, date and seller, which backs up your EPR filings. You still file on the CPCB portal.

carbonCredits.a: Not yet. We record every kilo now so credits can be issued later, once the method is verified.

whatCanIBuy.a: Recycled material from verified recyclers, such as PET flakes, HDPE granules, kraft paper and aluminium ingots.

qualityWrong.q: What if the quality isn't what I ordered?
qualityWrong.a: The demo shows proposed dispute steps. It cannot hold or protect real funds.

recycledContent.q: Does buying recycled help with EPR?
recycledContent.a: Yes. Plastic EPR rules set recycled-content targets for packaging, and your trade records show how much recycled material you bought.

carbonClaims.a: Your Impact screen estimates the carbon saved. Treat these numbers as indicative until they are independently verified.

whoCanJoin.a: Anyone 18 or older who wants to earn from short jobs near home.

whichId.a: Voter ID, driving licence, PAN, a DigiLocker document, or an Aadhaar that shows only the last 4 digits.

fullAadhaar.a: We never keep Aadhaar numbers. If you upload a full one by mistake, we'll ask for a masked copy and delete the first.

needVehicle.a: No. Shop help and shifts don't need one. For home pickups, a cycle, bike or auto helps.

whoPaysMe.a: The kabadiwala or business you work for. Agree the amount before you start.

chooseHours.q: Can I choose when I work?
chooseHours.a: Yes. You tell us the times and days you're free, and you take only the jobs you want.

safetyGear.q: What safety gear do I need?
safetyGear.a: Gloves and closed shoes for every job, and a mask for dusty work. Ask the business if they need anything more.

whoSeesId.q: Who sees my ID and selfie?
whoSeesId.a: Only you and our team, to check it's really you.

jobWentWrong.q: Something went wrong on a job. What do I do?
jobWentWrong.a: First, stay safe. Tell the business, then call us. We'll listen to both sides.

stockIntake.confirm: I confirm this is our own produced byproduct and this weighed quantity has not already been recorded in stock.
stockIntake.empty: No production stock intakes recorded yet.
stockIntake.noMaterials: No approved non-hazardous byproduct materials match this business. Ask the platform administrator to review the material before recording stock.
stockIntake.conflict: This intake reference already has different details. Check the original record before continuing.
stockIntake.note: These are manufacturer declarations, not independent quality, ownership or regulatory verification. Records cannot be edited after saving.

tradeLifecycle.title: Payment and delivery
tradeLifecycle.policyMissing: Live payments require approved payment terms and provider setup.
tradeLifecycle.reviewRequired: An administrator must check the payment evidence before this order can move forward.
tradeLifecycle.fullQuantity: Confirm the full agreed quantity: {weight}. If the quantity or quality differs, stop and contact the administrator.
tradeLifecycle.cancelNote: Cancellation releases stock only after the server confirms that no payment can still complete. A pending request does not mean the order is cancelled.
tradeLifecycle.failed: The update did not complete. Check the current status, then try again. Your reference is retained.
tradeLifecycle.actionUnavailable: This action is no longer available. Check the updated order status.

logistics.title: Route and load plans
logistics.lead: Manual planning only. All stop loads are added together. Straight-line ordering is not road routing, an ETA or dispatch. Locations come from your entries, not photo metadata.
logistics.conflict: The plan or your access changed. Reload before saving again.
logistics.invalid: Check coordinates, material, whole grams and capacity. All stops together must fit the vehicle.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.lead: Plan demand, record your supplier decisions and agree individual supply releases.
sourcing.boundary: These records do not create a trade, reserve stock or confirm payment. Use the marketplace and payment workflow for a purchase.
sourcing.planHint: Each occurrence is published only when you select Publish next demand. No automatic order is created.
sourcing.limited: Only a bounded set is shown. Older records remain in the audit history.
sourcing.invalid: Check the required fields, dates and whole-number quantities.
sourcing.failed: This action could not be completed. Your draft is retained. Check current permissions and eligibility, then try again.
sourcing.privateDecision: This is your organisation's sourcing decision. It is not platform approval or regulatory certification. The decision history is private to your buyer workspace. The latest decision for a supplier and material controls new agreements and releases; earlier entries remain in the history.
sourcing.agreementHint: An approved current supplier decision for this exact specification is required. The supplier must acknowledge the proposal separately.
sourcing.releaseHint: Request part of the agreed quantity. Supplier acknowledgement records intent only; it does not move material or money.
sourcing.closeHint: This prevents new releases. Existing releases and their history remain recorded.
sourcing.readOnly: Your workspace role can view these records but cannot change them.
sourcing.rescheduleHint: Choose a later current date. Previous publications remain unchanged. This does not publish a demand or create an order.
sourcing.overdue: This scheduled date has passed. Move the next date before publishing.

operations.standardsHint: Search reviewed definitions. A grade or sector does not grant handling permission or certify quality.
operations.workspaceRequired: Select an approved business workspace to continue.
operations.search: Search material, state, grade or specification
operations.truncated: The result is limited. Refine your search or check the recent records.
operations.reviewHint: These are administrator reviews of supplied evidence. A changed facility, superseded registration, expiry or revocation invalidates the current scope.
operations.destinationHint: Check the material scope and current authorisation before a controlled hand-off. A directory entry does not prove disposal or portal submission.
operations.productionHint: Link recipes and declared inputs to a measured transformation and its output inspection. The recycled fraction describes declared input, not certified product content. These records do not change stock.
operations.name: Name
operations.recipeHint: Use a new version for a correction. Ingredient shares must total 10,000 basis points. All measured ingredients and additives must be included in the linked transformation.
operations.failed: Could not save. Check the values, linked records and your workspace access, then retry.
operations.invalid: Check the fields and exact gram totals.
operations.batchHint: Select an existing transformation with an inspection of its output. Declare recycled grams for every input and give the evidence reference. This is an attributable declaration, not independent certification.

qualityDocuments.title: Quality documents
qualityDocuments.lead: Attach evidence to an inspection. Buyer decisions are separate from the inspector’s observations and do not move stock or payment.
qualityDocuments.readOnly: Your workspace role can read these records.
qualityDocuments.limit: Up to 100 recent records are shown in each section.
qualityDocuments.fileHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MiB. Use flattened PDFs. Files are downloaded, not previewed. Content is not independently verified or scanned for malware. Remove private details before sharing.
qualityDocuments.error: Could not complete this action. Check the file, access and connection, then try again.

auditReports.title: Shared audit reports
auditReports.lead: Read a fixed evidence snapshot shared for a stated purpose. Stakeholder approval does not grant access to other business records.
auditReports.warning: Share only the selected inspection and checked files. Remove personal details first. Recipients may retain downloads. Access can last up to 90 days and can be revoked; revocation cannot recall downloaded copies.
auditReports.error: Could not update this report. Check the expiry, selected records and your access.
auditReports.snapshot: Fixed snapshot of the inspecting business’s declaration. This is not a certificate or independent verification.
auditReports.limit: Up to 100 recent records and approved recipients are shown.

accountRemoval.activeCollection: Resolve the active collection before closing this account.
accountRemoval.assignedWork: Resolve your assigned work or handover first.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This policy covers the Luma.Green website and Android, iOS, Windows and macOS apps.
privacy.dataBody: We use account and contact details, your chosen location, photos, documents, business checks and transaction/security records to provide recycling services and protect accounts.
privacy.sharingBody: Authorized participants and configured hosting, SMS, verification, payment and optional AI providers receive needed data. Processing can occur outside India.
privacy.choicesBody: Location and notifications require permission. Choose files yourself. Sign-in uses session cookies. Analytics is opt-in; error reporting is separate. Manage permissions in device settings.
privacy.requestsBody: Remove your account below, or email support for access, correction or deletion. Verify ownership; do not email identity documents. Resolve open work or ownership first.
privacy.retentionBody: Closure removes login access and credentials. Business, payment, safety and audit evidence can remain for review. It does not erase every record. Ask support about retention and timing.
